meta.summary: Manufacturing company at 1200 employees sets AI envelopes at 0.5x sector median, with loose controls calibrated for early experimentation.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: Employee-card AI purchases under $50/month are reimbursable once per employee per quarter; amounts above $50/month require manager approval before purchase.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 90% before month end or single session exceeds 2x daily baseline
Team envelope burn exceeds 110% of monthly allocation or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in 24 hours
Company envelope burn exceeds 100% before month end or agent kill threshold breached and loop continues

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $400/month Support envelope and is correctly classified as COGS under the production environment rule; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $700/month Data envelope; the job is tagged and attributed, so it passes without intervention.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely cause is a prompt-length regression or model version change introduced in the deploy, requiring Engineering lead review.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent hit 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 50-retry-per-task limit, and context grew each cycle in violation of the 65% max context growth rule; the loop is blocked, preventing an estimated $1,090 in runaway spend.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window and the requested delta falls within the $1,200 max delta cap; the exception is approved.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step 2 throttle; experimentation is preserved at baseline rate while the Engineering lead resolves attribution within the 12-hour window.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $600 single-transaction ceiling and falls under the dataset-license merchant scope on the agent card; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month overlaps with the Sales tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool was submitted as COGS; the internal-tool project tag rule overrides the environment signal and reclassifies the spend as OpEx.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconciled with no outstanding blocks or unresolved escalations.
